item.title: A quieter browser: long titles should remain readable in a narrow reader window without hiding any actions
item.description:
A useful reader keeps your sources together.

Read at your own pace, save an article, and open the original when you need it.

Good reading needs room to breathe. Keep useful sources nearby, return to a saved story, and let the original article open only when you choose.
